fields.label: National Identity Number
fields.description: Norwegian national identity number (fødselsnummer), used as the tax identification number for individuals who are assigned one.

fields.label: D Number
fields.description: Norwegian D number (D-nummer), an identification number used as a tax identification number for eligible foreign individuals who do not meet the requirements for a national identity number.

fields.label: Organisation Number
fields.description: Nine-digit organisation number assigned by the Central Coordinating Register for Legal Entities and used as the tax identification number for legal entities.
